full_text: Intro Encompass® API Development Services Encompass is the foremost choice in the mortgage world and has been developed to cater to every lending task. However, there’s always room for innovation and improvement, even with such remarkable technology. With complete access to open APIs, we can build solutions for your Encompass instance so you can manage your customers with exceptional service that sets you apart from the competition. Full Name Email Contact No. Message Page URL Home » Encompass API Development Services From Pre-Qual To Closing, We Help Amplify Your Loan Processes ATI is a leading provider of services related to loan origination systems, including the powerful Encompass®. Our team of expert developers has in-depth knowledge of the Encompass® Developer Connect™ and its various APIs (application programming interfaces). We have a proven track record of helping lenders harness the full power of their LOS through API integration. Whether you want to create, delete, or manage loans more efficiently, update document properties effortlessly, or access and update borrower information – we’ve got you covered. ATI excels in integrating external data and solutions into Encompass®. Leverage our expertise to connect with credit agencies, verification services, appraisal providers, and other critical service partners, enhancing your operational efficiency and data accuracy. Encompass® offers multiple APIs to facilitate integrations and data exchange: RESTful API This API follows REST architecture principles, allowing developers to interact with Encompass® using standard HTTP methods. Responses are provided in formats like JSON or XML, and commonly used for data retrieval, loan creation, borrower information, and related functionalities. SOAP API In addition to the RESTful API, Encompass® also supports a SOAP API (Simple Object Access Protocol). SOAP is a messaging protocol that uses XML to structure messages. The SOAP API is used for more complex integrations and allows for robust error handling and additional security features. LLP API The Loan Level Pricing (LLP) API is specific to pricing and rate lock information in the mortgage industry. It allows users to access and update rate lock data for different loan products directly from external systems. TPO API The Third-Party Origination (TPO) API is designed to support integrations with third-party service providers, such as brokers or correspondent lenders. It facilitates the exchange of information between Encompass® and external partners. WE MASTER EVERYTHING ENCOMPASS® Whether you’re venturing into Encompass® for the first time or seeking to refine your current configuration, count on us for exceptional solutions The ATI Advantage Expert Team Our skilled developers deeply understand Encompass® Developer Connect™, ensuring seamless API integration and unmatched performance. Innovation & Efficiency We are committed to helping you unlock innovation and enhance operational efficiency through our API development services, giving you the competitive advantage you deserve. Personalized Support We take the time to understand your unique business requirements and provide custom solutions to fulfill your needs. ATI is your trusted partner for Encompass® API Development. Let us empower your organization with the latest API solutions to drive growth, optimize processes, and deliver an unparalleled customer experience. Custom API Solutions for Encompass® Our software engineers specialize in developing tailor-made API solutions that align perfectly with your company’s requirements. eFolder Enhancement With our API development services, experience improved eFolder functionalities. Effortlessly upload and download documents, attach files, and assign/reassign them to specific documents. Stay organized and streamline your document management process like never before. Contact Management Manage borrower and business contacts with ease using our APIs. Our developers will enable you to access and update contact information within the Encompass® database, ensuring accurate and up-to-date records. Advanced Data Handling ATI enables you to create, store, and manage custom data objects that go beyond standard fields in Encompass®. Our APIs support the loan, user, and global-level custom data objects, empowering you with more flexible and comprehensive data management. Real-time Event Notifications Stay informed about critical loan events instantaneously. Our API solutions leverage webhooks to notify you immediately when specific loan events occur in Encompass®, enabling you to take timely actions and improve overall efficiency. Our Hand-Crafted Plugins & Solutions Make Your Encompass® Instance Better EXPLORE ALL AN ABUNDANCE OF TECHNOLOGICAL DELIGHTS Discover the transformative power of these incredible tools that fit into your loan-originating system. Built with security and compliance in mind, our plugins adhere to industry standards to safeguard sensitive loan data. Looking For Something Else? Find answers to common questions about our Encompass® API Development Services What is an Encompass® API, and how can it benefit my business? An Encompass API is a set of tools and protocols that allow different software applications to communicate and interact with Encompass®, empowering your business with enhanced capabilities, streamlined workflows, and improved data accuracy. It opens up endless possibilities for innovation, process automation, and delivering a superior customer experience. What types of integrations can be achieved with the Encompass® API? Our API Development Services can help integrate your Encompass® with credit agencies for credit reports, verification services for employment and income verification, appraisal providers, title companies, and more. It also lets you connect with custom applications, data warehouses, and business intelligence tools to gain valuable insights into your mortgage operations. What are some typical use cases for custom Encompass® API solutions? Automating loan data entry and processing for faster loan origination Integrating eFolders with external document repositories to enhance document management Streamlining borrower and business contact management to maintain up-to-date records Building real-time notifications for critical loan events to improve response times Creating custom data objects to store extra info excluded by standard Encompass® fields Adding third-party services like credit reports, & appraisals for a smoother loan process Is the Encompass® API secure for data exchange with external systems? Yes, the Encompass® API is designed with security as a top priority. ICE Mortgage Technology® employs industry-standard security practices to safeguard data exchanged through the API. These measures include encryption protocols, authentication mechanisms, and access controls to ensure that data remains confidential and protected during transit. How can I get started with Encompass® API Development Services? Reach out to our team via our contact page or give us a call to discuss your specific requirements and business goals. Our professionals will work closely with you to understand your needs and create a customized plan to leverage the Encompass® APIs effectively. If there’s anything else you’d like to know, feel free to reach out.
